cases.source: h = 0.99^n over 3000 samples: the exact tail is a straight line to 1e-26 dB, so C = 0
a fast decay plus a weak slow one: the exact tail of the sum with its cross term bends toward the slow slope, so T30 > T20
the two-slope response times e^(0.7jn): |h| unchanged, same C
0.9^n over 25 samples: the last tail is 0.81^24 (1 - 0.81) / (1 - 0.81^25) of the total, about -29 dB, so T30 never reaches -35 dB
